text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — planning a two-step TF apply in the 21:00 UTC change window tonight: network routing updates (small route table and SG tweaks) followed by IAM role binding cleanup. Keeping them separate to minimize blast radius.
Ashwin Patel: SG diffs look tiny on plan. Do we have a provider/module pin for the network module? last time the module bump changed resource names.
Maria Chen: Good call. Locked module version in the branch to v3.2.1 and pinned aws provider to 4.65.0 in the root.
Deploy Bot: @channel deploybot: queued terraform-plan for branch "netiam/route-iam-cleanup" — plan id pb-19023. Run window: 21:00-21:30 UTC.
Leo Ramos: I can run the network apply at 21:00. SRE will watch control-plane metrics and I/O.
SRE Oncall: I'll have dashboards live and set an alert threshold. If 5m error rate > 3% or lat p95 increases by 40% we halt and rollback.
Katie Nguyen: For rollback, what's our fast path? revert the PR and reapply? or terraform state rollback?
Ben Ortiz: Fastest is revert PR + reapply with the previous head. We should avoid manual state edits. Have a revert PR ready and keep the old plan saved.
Maria Chen: Revert PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 — title "revert: netiam route cleanup". If network apply fails, we'll trigger that and run apply against previous head.
Ashwin Patel: Plan snippet from pb-19023:
```
# module.network.aws_route.main[2] will be updated in-place
~ aws_route.main[2]
    destination_cidr_block: "10.2.0.0/16" => "10.3.0.0/16"
# 1 to change, 0 to add, 0 to destroy
```
Maria Chen: We'll set deploybot to serialized mode: only net apply first. After net apply success and 10m observation, we'll run IAM apply.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: starting terraform apply (plan pb-19023) — operator: @Leo Ramos
Leo Ramos: Running now: `terraform apply -auto-approve -input=false` (targeted to modules/network).
Deploy Bot: deploybot: apply completed for pb-19023 — 1 resource updated. No drift detected.
SRE Oncall: Observing metrics — no spike, latency stable. Proceed with IAM apply in 10m.
Maria Chen: Reminder: IAM apply is constrained to service account bindings; pinning roles to avoid naming changes. If anything unexpected, use revert PR.
Ben Ortiz: Also note: state lock will be held by deploybot. If you need to take the lock, ping me.
Ashwin Patel: One nit — add an emergency env var BAILOUT=true to skip the IAM apply if we need to abort quickly. I can add a short runbook step.
Maria Chen: Added to runbook. Final checks: any objections?
Katie Nguyen: :thumbsup: from me.
Leo Ramos: :thumbsup: starting watch.
SRE Oncall: I'll open a pager if thresholds cross.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: scheduled terraform apply for IAM in 10m under operator @Maria Chen.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. If IAM apply fails we'll trigger revert PR and tag @infra-oncall for assistance.
Ben Ortiz: Post-apply, let's snapshot relevant route tables and IAM bindings for quick audit.
Maria Chen: Noted. Closing thread unless anything else shows up.
